svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drawn upside down: stand the box on its top, back face toward you;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top view then shows the bottom face as you see it on the bench.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure from the back face, and sideways from the centre line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (left and right as seen from the front). See the drilling layout.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back row, 28 from the back face: valve gland 62 left, chlorine gland

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 22 left, spare (plugged) 22 right, temperature gland 62 right: 16.2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front row, 70 from the back face: panel gland 62 left, optics gland

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 22 left (16.2 mm); vent 22 right (12.2 mm); antenna 62 right (6.5 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the face, pilot drill 3 mm slowly with wood behind, open out with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a step drill, light pressure. No solvents: polycarbonate crazes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check each hole size on the part's datasheet before the last step.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the maker's four lugs to the back corners, feet on top and bottom.
